questions.q: What are the standard dimensions for an average automobile parking slot when using perpendicular or diagonal orientation?
questions.n: This is the standard size for perpendicular or diagonal car parking, providing a total area of 12.50 square meters.

questions.q: For a residential townhouse (R-4) with a gross floor area (GFA) of 160.00 square meters, how many parking slots must be provided?
questions.n: The code mandates two parking slots for townhouse units that exceed 150.00 square meters in GFA.

questions.q: What is the minimum required dimension for an articulated truck parking slot?
questions.n: This length is necessary to accommodate a 12.00-meter container van plus a long/hooded prime mover.

questions.q: In highly urbanized areas, what is the parking requirement for a Hotel (Division B-1)?
o: One (1) slot for every three (3) rooms
One (1) slot for every ten (10) rooms
One (1) slot for every seven (7) rooms
questions.n: Highly urbanized areas require a higher density of parking at one slot per three rooms or a fraction thereof.

questions.q: What is the standard dimension for a Jeepney or Shuttle parking/loading slot?
questions.n: The code specifies 3x9 meters to accommodate the length and boarding space needed for public utility jeepneys.

questions.q: For a shopping center or supermarket, how is the number of required car slots calculated?
o: One (1) slot for every 1,000.00 sqm of GFA
One (1) slot for every 50.00 sqm of GFA
One (1) slot for every 100.00 sqm of shopping floor area
One (1) slot for every 30.00 sqm of customer area
questions.n: The code uses 100 sqm of shopping area as the unit for neighborhood centers and supermarkets.

questions.q: According to the code, what happens to parking slots provided outside the building/structure line?
o: They are quantified only as buffer parking
They must be converted to RROW
They are credited toward the minimum requirement
questions.n: Slots outside the building footprint do not count toward the legal minimum and are labeled as buffer parking.

questions.q: What is the parking requirement for a Private Hospital (Division D-2)?
o: One (1) slot for every twelve (12) beds
One (1) slot for every twenty-five (25) beds
One (1) slot for every fifty (50) beds
questions.n: Private hospitals are required to provide more parking, at one slot for every 12 beds.

questions.q: Which dimension is used for parallel car parking slots?
questions.n: Parallel parking requires less width but more length to allow for safe entry and exit between other vehicles.

questions.q: For industrial buildings (Group F), one loading slot for a standard truck must be provided for every ____ square meters of Gross Floor Area (GFA).
questions.n: Industrial and large commercial buildings require one loading slot per 5,000 sqm of GFA.

questions.q: A residential unit has a lot area of 110.00 square meters and a dwelling unit GFA of 35.00 square meters. What is the minimum required parking?
o: One (1) pooled slot for every four (4) lots
One (1) off-street cum on-site parking slot per lot
One (1) pooled slot for every six (6) lots
questions.n: Units with lot areas between 100.00 to 120.00 square meters require a dedicated 1:1 parking ratio.

questions.q: What is the specific parking requirement for an 'Open Market' residential condominium unit as defined under the revised IRR of PD 957?
o: One (1) pooled slot per eight (8) units
One (1) pooled slot per six (6) units
One (1) pooled slot per four (4) units
One (1) parking slot for each unit
questions.n: Open market units, regardless of size (unless exceeding 100 sqm where the rule remains the same), require a 1:1 parking ratio.

questions.q: For a nightclub or theater-restaurant, one (1) car slot is required for every how many square meters of customer area?
questions.n: Nightclubs and theater-restaurants have a higher parking demand intensity than regular restaurants.

questions.q: An office condominium unit has a gross floor area of 65.00 square meters. What is the minimum parking requirement?
o: One (1) pooled slot for every two units
One (1) parking slot for the unit
Two (2) parking slots for the unit
questions.n: Units between 41.00 and 70.00 square meters in office/commercial condos require one dedicated slot.

questions.q: What is the car parking requirement for a Public Hospital (Division D-2)?
questions.n: Public hospitals have a more relaxed car parking ratio compared to private ones.

questions.q: A hotel located in a 'non-urbanized' area has 70 rooms. How many car parking slots are required?
questions.n: In other areas, the ratio is 1 slot per 7 rooms (70 / 7 = 10).

questions.q: What is the requirement for passenger loading spaces at a Public Elementary School?
o: One (1) loading space for two (2) queued jeepney/shuttle slots
One (1) loading space for four (4) queued jeepney slots
questions.n: Public elementary and secondary schools must provide off-RROW loading for two queued jeepneys.

questions.q: For a transit station, how many queued jeepney/shuttle slots must be accommodated in the passenger loading space on each side of the RROW?
questions.n: Transit stations (Division E-1) must accommodate at least four queued jeepneys on each side of the RROW.

questions.q: A workplace has 250 workers. How many jeepney/shuttle slots must be provided for passenger loading if it is a Division F-1 occupancy?
o: None, only car slots are required
questions.n: When workers exceed 200, the building must provide an off-RROW space for two queued jeepneys.

questions.q: In a Public Market, what is the parking requirement for 'vendors' (sellers)?
o: One (1) jeepney/shuttle slot per 300.00 sqm of market area
One (1) jeepney/shuttle slot per 150.00 sqm of market area
questions.n: Vendors are allocated one slot or loading space for every 300 sqm of wet and dry market area.

questions.q: What is the parking ratio for a columbarium?
o: One (1) car slot per compartment niche
questions.n: The code requires one slot for every compartment niche (though this is often considered quite high in practical design).

questions.q: What is the car parking requirement for a Private College or University?
o: One (1) car slot per five (5) classrooms
One (1) car slot per three (3) classrooms
One (1) car slot per ten (10) classrooms
questions.n: Private higher education institutions have the highest car parking requirement among schools.

questions.q: For assembly buildings like stadia or convention centers, what is the bus parking requirement?
questions.n: Large public assembly buildings must provide one bus slot for every 200 spectators.

questions.q: What are the dimensions of a parking slot for a 'standard truck'?
questions.n: A standard truck or bus requires a width of 3.60m and a length of 12.00m.

questions.q: Which residential lot size triggers the requirement for one (1) pooled off-street parking slot for every four (4) lots?
questions.n: This range requires a 1:4 pooled parking ratio.

questions.q: In a residential subdivision, what is the GFA range for a dwelling unit that requires one pooled slot per six (6) lots?
questions.n: The smallest dwelling units (socialized/economic housing levels) have a 1:6 pooled ratio.

questions.q: For a motel, what is the minimum parking requirement?
o: One (1) car slot for every five units
One (1) car slot for every unit
One (1) car slot for every ten units
One (1) car slot for every three units
questions.n: Motels are defined by having a dedicated parking space for every guest room.

questions.q: What is the bus parking requirement for a residential hotel or apartel?
o: One (1) bus slot for every sixty (60) rooms
One (1) bus slot for every one hundred (100) rooms
questions.n: Residential hotels and apartels must provide one bus slot for every 60 units or a fraction thereof.

questions.q: How many loading slots for articulated trucks are required for a private hospital with 10,000 sqm GFA?
o: None, hospitals only need car slots
questions.n: Since the ratio is 1 per 5,000 sqm of GFA, 10,000 sqm requires exactly two loading slots.

questions.q: What is the car parking requirement for a bowling alley?
o: One (1) slot for every two (2) alleys
One (1) slot for every four (4) alleys
questions.n: The code requires 1 slot for every 4 bowling lanes.

questions.q: In a Church or place of worship, what is required for every 50.00 square meters of congregation area?
o: One (1) car slot and one (1) jeepney/shuttle slot
questions.n: Churches must provide for both private and public transport per 50 sqm of area.

questions.q: Which building type uses 'spectator area' as the basis for its parking calculation?
questions.n: Theaters and auditoria (Division H-1) calculate parking based on the square meters of spectator area.

questions.q: What is the car parking requirement for a Clubhouse or Beach House?
o: One (1) slot for every 200.00 sqm GFA
One (1) slot for every 50.00 sqm GFA
One (1) slot for every 100.00 sqm GFA
One (1) slot for every 30.00 sqm GFA
questions.n: Clubhouses and similar recreational buildings require 1 slot per 100 sqm.

questions.q: For 'Agriculture-related uses' (Division J-1) located within an urbanized area, how many car slots are required?
o: One (1) car slot for every 500.00 sqm GFA
One (1) car slot per 100 sqm GFA
One (1) car slot for every 1,000.00 sqm GFA
questions.n: Within urban areas, J-1 follows the industrial ratio of 1:1,000 sqm.

questions.q: What is the required car parking for a Mental Hospital (Division D-1)?
questions.n: Mental hospitals and sanitaria follow the same 1:25 ratio as public hospitals.

questions.q: A daycare or nursing home for children over kindergarten age requires one car slot for every ____ beds.
questions.n: Nursing homes, orphanages, and schools for children over kindergarten age require 1 slot per 12 beds.

questions.q: For terminals and depots (Division E-1), what is the car parking requirement per square meter of GFA?
questions.n: Terminals and depots require one car slot for every 500 sqm of GFA.

questions.q: What is the requirement for bus slots in an industrial building (Group F) with 500 workers?
questions.n: Industrial buildings require one bus slot for every 100 workers (500 / 100 = 5).

questions.q: In a residential condominium (R-5), what is the parking ratio for units with a GFA between 18.00 and 22.00 square meters?
questions.n: The smallest studio units in a condo have a pooled parking ratio of 1 per 8 units.

questions.q: Which vehicle requires a width of 2.15 meters for its parking slot?
questions.n: Parallel parking slots for automobiles are narrower at 2.15 meters compared to perpendicular slots.

questions.q: What is the minimum length for a parallel parking slot?
questions.n: Parallel parking slots are longer (6.00m) to allow for the maneuvering needed to park between two other cars.

questions.q: What is the required width for an articulated truck slot?
questions.n: All heavy trucks and buses in the code require a minimum width of 3.60 meters.

questions.q: How many tourist bus parking slots must be provided for a theater-restaurant?
o: None, only car slots are required
questions.n: Theater-restaurants, like hotels, must provide two tourist bus parking slots.

questions.q: For a public market of 2,000 sqm GFA, how many tricycles must the off-RROW terminal accommodate?
questions.n: Since the ratio is 6 tricycles per 1,000 sqm, a 2,000 sqm market requires 12 spaces.

questions.q: What is the parking requirement for a pension, boarding, or lodging house?
o: One (1) car slot for every twenty (20) beds
One (1) car slot for every ten (10) beds
One (1) car slot for every five (5) rooms
One (1) car slot for every unit
questions.n: Boarding houses are calculated at one slot per twenty beds.

questions.q: For aircraft hangars (Division E-3), how many bus slots are required for every 100 workers?
o: None, only car slots are required
questions.n: Like industrial and warehouse uses, hangars require one bus slot per 100 workers.

questions.q: What is the car parking requirement for aircraft hangars or open carports (Division E-3)?
questions.n: Hangars and industrial-style garages use the 1:1,000 sqm ratio for car slots.

questions.q: For Group H-4 (Amusement Parks), what is the car parking requirement for every 50.00 sqm of GFA?
o: One (1) car and one (1) jeepney slot
questions.n: Amusement parks have high parking demand and require 1 slot per 50 sqm of GFA.

questions.q: What is the requirement for a building's maneuvering area for trucks and buses?
o: It must be provided outside of the RROW (within property lines)
It may occur on the RROW during off-peak hours
It is not required if the street is wide enough
It can be shared with the sidewalk
questions.n: All maneuvering for large vehicles must happen entirely within the lot lines of the development.

questions.q: For a private university, what is the required student count to trigger the need for one (1) school bus slot?
questions.n: Private schools and universities must provide one school bus slot for every 100 students.

questions.q: What is the passenger loading space requirement for a private hospital?
o: One (1) space for four (4) queued jeepneys
One (1) space for two (2) queued jeepney/shuttle slots
Loading is not required if there is an ambulance bay
questions.n: Private hospitals must accommodate two queued public utility vehicles for loading.

questions.q: A neighborhood shopping center has 500 sqm of shopping floor area. How many car slots are required?
questions.n: Shopping centers require 1 slot per 100 sqm, so 500 sqm requires 5 slots.

questions.q: Which dimension represents the 'width' of a standard automobile parallel parking slot?
questions.n: Parallel slots are allowed to be narrower (2.15m) because vehicles do not need to turn into them from the side.

questions.q: For 'other uses not classified' (Division J-2), what is the governing rule for parking requirements?
o: A standard ratio of 1 slot per 500 sqm applies
Always provide one (1) slot per 100 sqm GFA
Use requirements stipulated for the most similar or related use
questions.n: For unclassified uses, the Building Official applies the rules of the most similar occupancy.

questions.q: What is the requirement for the drawing of parking slots on the plans?
o: They may be represented as text only
They shall be drawn to scale and the total number indicated
Only the entrance and exit need to be shown
questions.n: Architectural compliance requires scaled drawings and a clear tabulation of the total slots.

questions.q: How many tourist bus parking slots must be provided for a standard hotel?
questions.n: The code mandates a minimum of two tourist bus slots for each hotel.

questions.q: For a private university, what is the car parking ratio?
questions.n: Private colleges and universities have a 1:3 ratio.

questions.q: A residential building has townhouses (R-4) with 100 sqm GFA. How many slots must be provided?
questions.n: Units between 50 and 150 sqm in an R-4 occupancy require one dedicated slot.

questions.q: What is the parking slot requirement for an indigenous family dwelling?
o: One (1) pooled slot for every eight (8) units
One (1) car slot for every six (6) dwelling units
questions.n: Indigenous family dwellings require 1 car slot for every 6 units, provided outside the RROW.

questions.q: For highly urbanized areas, what is the hotel room-to-parking ratio?
questions.n: Dense urban centers require one slot for every three hotel rooms.
